name: @wc-toolkit/dotnet-tools
description: Generates ASP.NET Tag Helpers and Blazor component wrappers from a Custom Elements Manifest and packs them into one NuGet package.

scripts.demo:razor-pages: pnpm build && node dist/__demo__/generate-demos.js && dotnet run --project src/__demo__/razor-pages
scripts.demo:blazor: pnpm build && node dist/__demo__/generate-demos.js && dotnet run --project src/__demo__/blazor
scripts.test:generated: pnpm build && node dist/__demo__/generate-demos.js && dotnet build src/__demo__/blazor/WebAwesome.BlazorDemo.csproj && dotnet build src/__demo__/razor-pages/WebAwesome.RazorPagesDemo.csproj && dotnet test test/Blazor
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build
